5 Daily Star journalists get DRU award
2017-11-26T12:59:41+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/5-daily-star-journalists-get-dhaka-reporters-unity-dru-best-reporting-award-2017-diplomacy-health-city-problem-liberation-war-1496695

Five journalists of The Daily Star have won the ‘ DRU Best Reporting Award-2017 ’ in four categories of print media.

Inam Ahmed and Shakhawat Liton jointly got the award for their reports on diplomacy, Porimol Palma on health, Helemul Alam on city’s problem and prospects and Mohammad Al-Masum Molla on Liberation War.

Information Minister Hasanul Haq Inu handed over the awards to them at a ceremony at Dhaka Reporters’ Unity (DRU) in Dhaka.

A total of 27 awards will be given to journalists in different categories this year.
